notes.title: The Legend of Skye 1.3.3
notes.content:
Correction of a bug in Bard's store.

Added some hints for the puzzles: the enchanted forest, the peddler druid and the bucket in the shaman's house.

Saved games are not damaged.

notes.title: The Legend of Skye - Available DEMO
notes.content:
A small demo of the game's prologue is now available. A few things to keep in mind:

- The English translation of the demo will not be exactly the same as the one of the game.
- The full version of the game will also be in German.
- The soundtrack is also provisional.
- There is nothing definitive, even in the prologue. I am open to listen to all your opinions and to change things.
- I need your feedback to make Legend of Skye a great game!
